title: Finch Circle Points Accounting — Computing the Late Credit on a Missing-Points Request
content:
**Scope of the computation.** For a missing-points request of the Finch Circle Loyalty Program this policy handles, and only for such a request, the credit is one points adjustment entry made of the late-credit purchase points, the late-credit bonus event points and the late-credit card bonus points of the claimed unit worked out below, on the qualifying amount of a unit the member still keeps, read at the tier on the membership record on the request date; every other points entry remains under the base earning rules. For the claimed unit, and only for that unit, the purchase points and the bonus event points are not posted as purchase points and bonus event entries at the purchase-date rate but are the late-credit purchase points and the late-credit bonus event points, folded into the one credit; and a charge to a Marlowe & Finch card earns no separate card bonus entry, its card bonus being the late-credit card bonus points, folded into the one credit. Every other purchase earns its purchase points, bonus event points and card bonus entry under the base earning rule.

**Computation clause.**

1. *Late-credit qualifying amount.* The claimed unit's unit price less the Finch Notes applied to it, both as the claimed unit's purchase record shows them.
2. *Late-credit purchase points.* The late-credit qualifying amount times the base points per dollar of the tier on the membership record on the request date, rounded down to whole points.
3. *The credit.* The credit is the late-credit purchase points, plus the late-credit bonus event points, plus the late-credit card bonus points.
4. *Late-credit bonus event points.* The late-credit purchase points times the tier's bonus event multiplier minus one, times the bonus event indicator, times the late-claim event share, times the price-type event share, rounded down to whole points. The tier is the one on the membership record on the request date.
5. *Late-credit card bonus points.* The late-credit qualifying amount times the late-credit card bonus rate, times the late-credit financing share, times the late-credit standing share, rounded down to whole points.
6. *Values.* The bonus event indicator is 1 when the membership carries a bonus event points entry posted on the claimed unit's purchase date, and 0 otherwise. The late-claim event share is the whole (1). The price-type event share is the whole (1). The late-credit card bonus rate is 0. The late-credit financing share is the whole (1). The late-credit standing share is none (0).

The base points per dollar and the bonus event multiplier of each tier are the product figures of the points earning schedule.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Unit price of the claimed unit, less Finch Notes applied to it | 150.00 less 20.00, that is 130.00 |
| Tier on the membership record on the request date | Finch Circle Platinum: 2 base points per dollar, bonus event multiplier 3 |
| Late-credit purchase points | 130.00 times 2, that is 260 points |
| Bonus event points entry posted on the unit's purchase date | yes, so the indicator is 1 |
| Late-credit bonus event points | 260 times 2 (3 minus one), times 1, times 1, times 1, that is 520 points |
| Late-credit card bonus points | 130.00 times 0, times 1, times 0, that is 0 |
| Credit | 260 plus 520 plus 0, that is 780 points |

With no bonus event points entry posted on the purchase date, the indicator is 0, the bonus event points are 0 and the credit is 260 points.

**Rounding (hypothetical).** A late-credit qualifying amount of 133.33 at 1.50 points per dollar gives 199.995, rounded down to 199 points.
